svg.text: Figure 1 · The system-level V, block by block
The 11 blocks of the SUS-I1 V as the page computes them: the side, the gate each block is due by, the records in it and how mature they are. A block takes the colour

Generated by tools/figures/vcycle_readme.py from the records through tools/vcycle/build_vcycle.py and the rules in page.html. Maturity is computed from record status for orientation only; nothing here is reviewed, verified or

g.text: Terms: CONOPS = concept of operations · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · SSF-nnn =

safety-significant software function record (safety/software/) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · UAV = uncrewed aerial
